title: Rita Gunther McGrath (Columbia Business School · Thinkers50 Top 10) — 'Loved your talk at the #nacdsummit and yes you can taste it!'
summary: The Columbia strategy professor, ranked in the Thinkers50 top ten and number one in strategy, caught the Directors Summit keynote and replied to Eric's line about value extraction being something customers can taste. She hosted him on her Thought Sparks podcast earlier this year.
blockquote: Loved your talk at the #nacdsummit and yes you can taste it!
